ONLY AT BOND OVER BINDINGS - PAN MAC MONTH

✨ A HEARTFELT THANK YOU! ✨

Whispered Pages: Edition 01 — Wordless Picture Books was a beautiful celebration of stories told without words, brought alive through imagination, observation, conversation and play.

A huge thank you to Kavita Singh Kale, Blossom Coelho & Anuradha Nambiar for making this first edition so special. ❤️

From the delightful world of Da Da Dance, to the tender humour of Ammachi’s Glasses, and the wonderfully mysterious Du Iz Tak?, each story invited children and families to look closer, think differently, and create their own stories.

Thank you for sharing your warmth, creativity and love for picture books with the Bond Over Bindings community.

Here’s to more pages whispered, stories imagined, and wonderful books discovered together! 📚✨

Whispered Pages — where every picture has a story to tell.

✨ *STORIES WE CELEBRATE* ✨
The stories behind the festivals we know and love.
